body:
Indeed every data we pass to user functions should be cloned. An easy and performant cloning mechanism is JSON.parse(JSON.stringify()).

Other cloning method are really big with a lot of cases. Since we know it's pure parsed JSON then we should be safe with JSON.parse(JSON.stringify()).
